title: PU-21-452 — Order Order
text:
13 PU-21-452 Filed 05/25/2022 Pages: 2
Order
Public Service Commission

require that any extension project designated as system betterment by MDU be listed
individually with supporting details and justification in MDU’s next general natural gas rate
case, and also holds North Dakota ratepayers harmless in the event a bond or letter of
credit from a developer fails to cover the required financial obligation for a main or service
line extension project. These changes serve to protect North Dakota ratepayers from
subsidizing growth projects or inadequate bonding.

Based on the record and having received no objections, the Commission finds
MDU’s proposed tariff revisions are reasonable and prudent.

Order

The Commission orders Montana-Dakota Utilities Co’s proposed tariff revisions
are APPROVED as filed on March 7, 2022, and March 15, 2022.

PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
